title: Live Updates: Rescuers Scour Remote Valleys, as Survivors Describe Families Swept Away
summary_full: Officials said hundreds were killed in Nepal and Tibet in a massive flood. Stunned witnesses described a torrent of debris and water carrying away villages in minutes.
